title: Unpushed Commits Review, PR Scoped Threads, Case-Sensitive Search & Persistent Theme Preferences
summary: Introduces unpushed commit reviews with sidebar hover cards and ref-aware diffing, PR scope integration for review threads, case-sensitive search toggle in the findbar and markdown preview, persistent theme preferences across reloads, and status bar version indicators.

categories.name: Unpushed Commit Review & Git Sidebar
items: Unpushed commit section in the sidebar git view listing local commits ahead of the tracking branch (@{u}..HEAD) with ref origin indicators
Interactive commit hover card displaying author, full commit message, colored diffstat insertions and deletions, and Copy SHA action
Clickable unpushed commit rows expanding touched files with status badges to review commit-specific diffs
Support optional ref query parameter across diff, gutter, and file API endpoints to review historical and unpushed commits
Card Keeper utility maintaining LSP and commit hover cards interactively open during mouse movement
Git view toggle remains accessible in the file tree when working tree is clean but unpushed commits exist
Prevent sidebar layout collapse on clean git working trees by properly anchoring bottom panels

categories.name: PR Review Scopes & Review Threads
items: PR diff scope selection (Whole PR, My changes, Selection) for review threads with dedicated scope chips
Pass explicit PR diff scopes and saved diff files directly to coding harnesses so agents read exact git ranges
Support pulling PRs when upstream branches are force-pushed without local commits
Calculate unpushed commits relative to PR head when working in detached HEAD mode
Synchronize PR head and index state automatically when local commits are pushed
Authenticate git push and pull operations using HTTP extra headers

categories.name: Case-Sensitive Search & Findbar
items: Match case toggle button in the findbar UI with active state styling
Case-sensitive search support across search APIs, find state models, and Markdown preview finder
Unified find state handling between code view and rendered Markdown documentation

categories.name: Theme Preferences & Status Bar
items: Theme preference resolution prioritizing custom choices over default fallbacks and persisting to server settings
Display current px0 version and title tooltip in the status bar with automatic initialization refresh
Streamline LSP backend by removing legacy diagnostic tracking in favor of responsive hover and jump navigation

categories.name: Telemetry & Internal Helpers
items: Wire telemetry service to HTTP server to record git commit events
Extract shared inGitMode helper to tree module to eliminate duplicate logic across prscope and unpushed views
